assets.name: 巡界盾手
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished standalone visual-novel DIALOGUE CHARACTER STANDING ILLUSTRATION for the game Midnight Commission.
Input image 1 is the exact enemy identity reference; preserve its identity, equipment, anatomy, materials and original color accents. Input images 2 and 3 (existing Noren and gang dialogue standing portraits) are the STYLE AND PROPORTION reference only; do not include those characters.
Match the established dialogue artwork: sharp expressive 2D anime ink outlines, angular large flat cel-shadow planes, restrained subtly textured surfaces, dark violet/charcoal shadow palette, pale warm highlights. This is a newly drawn dialogue portrait, not merely an enlargement of the combat sprite. For human characters use the taller, elegant full-body proportions of the existing dialogue portraits, not the large-headed chibi combat proportions. For non-human characters preserve their original species and mechanical anatomy, express personality through pose, NEVER turn them into humans.
Single isolated character, head/entire body/feet/props visible, relaxed conversational pose, three-quarter view with attention slightly toward viewer's left, portrait canvas approximately 1024x1536, centered, about 90% height, generous clean margin around all extremities. Authentic transparent alpha background, no scenery, no ground plane, no drop shadow, no checkerboard drawing, no aura behind character. Readable silhouette and face/eye focal point. No typography, labels, UI, watermark or extra characters. Keep pale solid materials opaque.
Specific subject: Same stern adult man with tied-back dark hair, cheek scar, olive scarf, muted gray-green work clothes, red cloth knot, huge battered rectangular viewing-slot shield and short-handled hammer. Tall grounded adult anatomy, shield resting beside him while he speaks, hammer lowered. Keep his face visible.
